title: Department of Information Technology
content: The Department of Information Technology (IT) focuses on the practical application of computing and information systems in corporate enterprises. It offers B.Tech in Information Technology and M.Tech in Information Security. The curriculum is designed in partnership with industry experts to cover core topics such as Database Management Systems (DBMS), Web Technologies, Cryptography, Mobile App Development, Enterprise Architecture, and Cloud Virtualization. The department has specialized labs for Network Simulation, Software Engineering, and Multimedia. Students are actively encouraged to take up industry certifications (e.g. AWS, Oracle, CCNA) and engage in semester-abroad programs (SAP) at partner universities in the USA, UK, and Europe.
